message.content: Columbia University is an Ivy League research university located in New York City. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University in 1896. It has a strong reputation across many disciplines, including journalism (the Pulitzer School), business (the Columbia Business School), law (the Columbia Law School), medicine (the Vagelos College of Physicians & Surgeons), and the arts (the School of the Arts). The campus is primarily situated on Morningside Heights in Manhattan, with additional facilities in Washington Heights, Brooklyn, and elsewhere.
